# SQLite Amalgamation
#
# Required for the SQLite backend. Not needed for PostgreSQL-only builds.
# Run from the repository root:

mkdir -p vendor/sqlite
curl -fsSL -o sqlite3.zip https://www.sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3510200.zip
unzip -jo sqlite3.zip "*/sqlite3.c" "*/sqlite3.h" -d vendor/sqlite
rm sqlite3.zip
sh vendor/verify-sqlite.sh

# verify-sqlite.sh checks sqlite3.c against the SHA3-256 SQLite publishes for this
# release, and sqlite3.h against a hash pinned from that same verified download,
# and fails if either differs; do not build from files that fail it. The Docker
# build and both CI jobs run the same check.
#
# Source: https://www.sqlite.org/download.html
